answer: Each identity locks a 10 POA copper bond. Each tick, a prism splits the beacon into a unique challenge per identity; each agent must answer in one epoch and keep a live thread of heartbeats. A missed check or broken thread slashes it. 100 fake identities cost 1,000 POA in bonds plus 200 POA per epoch in heartbeats, against ~90 POA reward, so the farm loses. An honest agent pays one bond once, keeps it by staying live, and earns undiluted rewards.
